name: Agnos
summary: Warm off-white studio site with a single hot orange accent, tight Geist headlines, handwritten Caveat asides and a dense bento of tactile white cards nested inside soft grey trays.

fonts.pairing: one grotesk at 500 with -0.03em tracking for every heading, Geist body in warm grey, Caveat script in orange for small handwritten callouts

signature: centered headline whose last word flips to orange, flanked by huge concentric embossed arcs carrying slowly rotating tool-icon tiles
Caveat script note with a hand-drawn arrow pointing at the primary button
white cards nested inside a 1px grey tray with a 16px outer and 8px inner radius, used for compare, bento, pricing and CTA
two opposing image tickers behind a centered badge card, faded at both edges
sticky scroll-driven process step that swaps variants as each stage scrolls past
imagery: studio flat-lays and product props on white, portraits shot against saturated orange, warm-toned project mockups
layout_grid: 1200px canvas, about 1000px content tray, 160px top padding per section, 4-column bento grids, 2-column pricing
